name: Hušnek
description: Dvužek's heavy mining barge, built for the belts a shallow hold cannot clear. Two high slots, the largest hold on the ring, and a hull built to carry it home. It strips a belt, warps home and repeats. It turns like a loaded skip and stops like one because of the hold. Co-op treasurers across the ring attribute Dvužek's expansion to the hold this barge brings home.
